fixtureManifest.extraction_command_template: ffmpeg -hide_banner -copyts -ss {T} -i '<source>' -map 0:v:0 -frames:v 1 -vf showinfo -fps_mode passthrough -pix_fmt yuv420p10le -f rawvideo -y source-{T}s.yuv 2>source-{T}s.log

fixtureManifest.pixel_processing: No transfer, tone-map, matrix conversion, resize or range conversion filter was used. Source software-decoded directly to yuv420p10le. The raw demux input initially has unspecified color metadata; setparams assigns the already-observed source limited/BT.2020/HLG tags before encoding. The decoded first-frame SHA-256 then exactly matches the source raw frame for every fixture. x265 Rate Control logs report Lossless.
fixtureManifest.rpu: Raw-frame roundtrip drops source packet-side Dolby Vision metadata; fixture probe shows no Dolby Vision configuration record or DOVI RPU frame side data. H.26[45] User Data Unregistered SEI entries in ffprobe are x265 encoder information, not DOVI data.
